verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a spend-management platform, but the evidence shows no first-party scheduler or recurring-workflow feature in Brex. The only recurring example, a monthly CSV export, runs on Zapier, a third-party integration, so it earns no credit. Brex's own automation (auto-approvals, policy enforcement, AI review agents) responds to events rather than running on a schedule. Workato's "monthly limits" are spend caps, not scheduled jobs.
